Good to know

Frequently asked questions

A few quick answers before you start sliding.

Slide & Solve is a classic number tile puzzle. Move the numbered tiles into the correct order by sliding them into the empty space.

Choose a board size, then tap a tile beside the empty space to move it. Keep arranging tiles until the numbers are in order. The game screen tracks your time and moves.

The app screens show six board sizes: 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, 6×6, 7×7, and 8×8.
